applicableAreas: Pre-release condition for site plan approval
findings.comment: Water Benchmarking Application is not documented in supplementary documents. OWB review comments reference a benchmarking application requiring updates, but no evidence of Austin Water director approval prior to site plan release has been provided. For 39-unit multi-family projects receiving Austin Water retail service, the Water Benchmarking Application must be submitted and approved by the director before release per LDC § 25-9-413(A); there is no exemption for revisions.

A current Surveyor's Certificate required per LDC § 25-1-82 for application completeness has not been located in supplementary documents. While Sheet 2 contains the historical 1975 surveyor certification for the Mecey Subdivision plat, a current surveyor's certificate for the Valley View Townhomes site plan (SP-2025-0126C) is not documented.
An Affidavit of No Liens has not been located in the supplementary documents submitted with the consolidated site plan application.

Placeholder text in recording document number field has not been replaced. Sheet 1, Block 12 states: 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas.' The document number field is blank and must be filled with the actual recorded document number.

Tenant notification note regarding building demolition is not present in plan notes. The site plan shows demolition of an existing structure (former assisted living facility). Per LDC § 25-1-712 and BCM 16.2, when occupied structures are proposed for demolition and the project involves 5 or more residential units (this project has 39 units), a plan note is required specifying that building demolition is subject to tenant notification regulations requiring a 120-day notification period before the building or demolition permit is approved.
